zh.title: 華航A350機上網路服務有差異　搭機前留意Wi-Fi供應與免費使用資格
zh.summary: 華航將A350列為提供機上Wi-Fi的機型，但官網同時註明特定航機暫無服務。能否連線與免費使用範圍是兩件事：經濟艙提供免費文字訊息，豪華商務艙、豪華經濟艙及指定會員則享免費網頁瀏覽，均以航機實際提供服務為前提。
body: 搭乘中華航空Airbus A350-900，機上網路體驗仍可能有所不同。華航在機上Wi-Fi官方說明中，將A350、B777及A321neo列為提供服務的機型，同時明確註明「特定 A350、A321neo 航機暫無提供 Wi-Fi」。因此，訂位資料顯示A350-900，或使用A359代碼，並不能直接當作該班機一定可上網的保證。
這項例外說明指的是服務是否可用，與旅客是否符合免費資格不同。華航在該服務頁未提供完整的逐架機號適用清單，也未逐一交代暫無服務的原因；僅憑機齡、客艙配置或過往所屬航空公司，還不足以確認某架飛機的網路狀態。需要在飛行途中聯絡或處理工作的旅客，宜在出發前向華航確認，並以上機後的服務說明為準。
在有提供Wi-Fi的航機上，免費方案也有使用範圍的差別。依華航公布的適用表，經濟艙旅客可使用免費文字訊息，涵蓋LINE、Messenger、iMessage及WhatsApp等通訊軟體；豪華商務艙、豪華經濟艙，以及華夏會員晶鑽卡、翡翠卡與金卡旅客，則可享免費無限網頁瀏覽。指定會員應在訂位購票或報到時提供會員卡號，以利資格驗證。
免費文字訊息不等於所有網路功能都免費開放。需要瀏覽網頁的旅客，若不符合免費瀏覽資格，可參考機上提供的付費方案；華航公布的售價為1小時11.95美元、3小時16.95美元、全程21.95美元。這些方案仍須以該航機實際提供Wi-Fi為前提，無法透過付費讓原本暫無服務的航機開放上網。
實際操作時，應遵照客艙指示，保持行動裝置為飛航模式，再開啟Wi-Fi連接Wi-Fi Onboard，依登入頁面選擇方案並完成驗證。華航B777／A350操作指南也提醒，若未自動出現登入頁面，可在瀏覽器輸入www.cal-wifi.com；如需更換方案，可嘗試忘記該Wi-Fi網路後重新連線。
即使已連上網路，也不代表全程速度穩定。華航說明，衛星訊號、天候、航線位置及同時使用人數等因素，都可能影響連線品質；操作指南建議關閉背景更新與雲端備份，並避免串流影音或大型檔案傳輸。對旅客而言，判斷機上網路是否符合需求，應同時確認該航機有沒有服務、所選方案能做什麼，以及飛行途中可能出現的連線限制。

en.title: China Airlines A350 Wi-Fi Availability and Complimentary Access Can Differ
en.summary: China Airlines lists the A350 as a Wi-Fi-equipped type but notes that service is unavailable on certain aircraft. Availability and free-access eligibility are separate: Economy receives messaging, while premium cabins and eligible frequent flyers receive browsing on aircraft offering the service.
body: A China Airlines Airbus A350-900 booking does not guarantee internet access. The airline lists the A350, B777 and A321neo as types offering onboard Wi-Fi, but explicitly excludes certain A350 and A321neo aircraft. An A359 aircraft code alone therefore cannot confirm availability.

The service page does not provide a complete registration-by-registration availability list or explain every exception. Aircraft age, cabin configuration and previous operator alone are insufficient evidence. Passengers relying on connectivity should check with China Airlines before departure and follow the information provided onboard.

Where service is available, Economy passengers receive complimentary text messaging through apps including LINE, Messenger, iMessage and WhatsApp. Premium Business and Premium Economy passengers, plus Dynasty Flyer Paragon, Emerald and Gold members, receive complimentary unlimited browsing. Eligible members should supply their membership number when booking or checking in.

Messaging access does not unlock every internet function. Published paid browsing prices are US$11.95 for one hour, US$16.95 for three hours and US$21.95 for the full flight. Purchasing a plan cannot enable service on an aircraft where Wi-Fi is unavailable.

Following cabin instructions, passengers should keep airplane mode enabled, connect to Wi-Fi Onboard and complete plan verification. The B777/A350 guide lists www.cal-wifi.com if the portal does not appear. To change plans, it suggests forgetting the Wi-Fi network and reconnecting.

Satellite connectivity can slow or disconnect because of weather, route, signal conditions and demand. The guide recommends disabling background updates and cloud backups and avoiding streaming or large transfers. Availability, plan benefits and connection limitations all matter when assessing whether onboard internet will meet a passenger’s needs.
